scenes.title: Hermes Agent
scenes.sub: Nous Research's open-source, self-hosted agent with persistent memory and self-improving skills.
scenes.say: This is Hermes Agent, from Nous Research: an open-source AI agent you host yourself.

scenes.heading: What it is
bullets: Skills that improve as it works
scenes.say: It keeps a persistent memory, builds skills that improve as it works, and has a built-in messaging gateway.

scenes.heading: How it runs
steps: CLI, desktop app, Docker, or Hermes Cloud
Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, email and more
scenes.say: Run it from the command line, the desktop app, Docker, or Hermes Cloud, with any model provider, and message it on Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp or email.

scenes.heading: Timeline
items: v0.21.0 Pantheon: Bot Mode in the desktop app
scenes.say: Its first public release shipped March 12, 2026. The latest, version 0.21.6, landed October 8.

scenes.heading: In VidiFlow HX
bullets: Research streams become Research agent beats
Findings land as VidiBuzz workstream tasks
Contingency nodes light up when Hermes waits on sources
scenes.say: In VidiFlow HX, its research streams become Research agent beats and VidiBuzz tasks.

scenes.title: VidiFlow
scenes.sub: Agent stacks that run your business at scale.
scenes.say: VidiFlow. Agent stacks that run your business at scale.
